highlights: Leading AI companies are rapidly advancing core model capabilities, evidenced by Google's new zero-shot multivariate time series forecasting model and OpenAI's custom inference chip designed for superior speed and efficiency.

The development of more robust and safer AI agents is accelerating, with Anthropic's new Model Hardware Standard facilitating secure physical device operation and novel frameworks emerging for efficient GUI agent training.

Tooling for AI development and deployment is expanding significantly, including Hugging Face's WebGPU kernels for local AI and Google's enhanced Gemini API, making powerful AI capabilities more accessible for builders.

agents.title: Anthropic Introduces Model Hardware Standard (MHS) for Safe AI Agent Operation
agents.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview of MHS, a shared driver specification enabling AI agents to safely discover and operate physical devices, drastically reducing integration time for hardware interaction while enforcing safety limits.

agents.title: WM-R1: Reinforcement Learning Framework Trains GUI Agents with World Models
agents.summary: WM-R1 introduces the first reinforcement learning framework for mobile GUI agents that leverages world models for training instead of real environments, significantly reducing resource costs and improving stability by enabling agents to reason about action consequences.

agents.title: Princeton, Ant Group, and Stanford Introduce AQuA for Autonomous Factor Discovery in Quantitative Finance
agents.summary: Researchers unveiled AQuA, a two-part agentic framework addressing the challenge of data corruption in quantitative finance by allowing autonomous factor discovery and model development without agents corrupting their own evidence, enhancing research integrity.

models.title: Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
models.summary: Google Research released TimesFM-3, a 330M parameter foundation model natively pretrained for multivariate time series forecasting, achieving top ranks on major benchmarks without task-specific fine-tuning, though under a non-commercial license.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator: Compact Multimodal, Multilingual, Reasoning-Enabled
models.summary: NVIDIA introduced Nemotron 3.5 CS, a compact 4B vision-language model for joint content safety moderation of user prompts, images, and assistant responses across 12 languages, capable of providing reasoning traces for policy application and audit.

models.title: Time Capsule of Testable Human Knowledge: 41 Years of Jeopardy! in a Single Local Model
models.summary: A study demonstrates that a single 9 GB open-weight model (Qwen2.5-14B) can encapsulate 41 years of Jeopardy! knowledge, achieving 67.0% accuracy on over half a million clues, showing portable and essentially free access to vast cultural knowledge.

tools.title: @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face released @huggingface/kernels, providing over 200 WebGPU kernels for local AI inference, enabling developers to run advanced AI models efficiently directly within web browsers with hardware acceleration.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents Expands with Flash, Hooks, and New Capabilities
tools.summary: Google announced new capabilities for Managed Agents in the Gemini API, including 3.6 Flash and hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents with advanced features and greater control.

tools.title: Keenable AI Open-Sources NEEDLE: Live Search Benchmark Rebuilds Query Set Hourly
tools.summary: Keenable AI open-sourced NEEDLE, a live search benchmark that rebuilds its query set every hour, preventing search agents from gaming the evaluation process by reading static answer keys, ensuring robust and fair assessment of web search APIs.

companies.title: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Ads Reaches $1 Billion Annualized Revenue Run Rate
companies.summary: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT Ads has hit a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate and is expanding globally, marking a significant commercial milestone that supports broader access to AI through free and affordable options.

companies.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño Custom Inference Chip Shows Industry-Leading Speed and Efficiency
companies.summary: OpenAI's custom inference chip, Jalapeño, demonstrated industry-leading speed and power efficiency for AI inference, promising higher throughput and lower latency for modern models, indicating a strategic advantage in AI hardware.

companies.title: Google Pics: Easy Image Creation and Editing Now in Google Workspace
companies.summary: Google launched Google Pics, an image creation and editing tool built on its Nano Banana model, now available in Google Workspace, providing users with easy-to-use AI capabilities for visual content directly within their productivity suite.

learning.title: Building Custom Batched Ensemble Weather Forecasting with NVIDIA Earth2Studio
learning.summary: This tutorial guides users through building an ensemble weather forecasting workflow using NVIDIA Earth2Studio, covering installation, model loading, data retrieval, and implementing custom diagnostics for practical application.

learning.title: Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive: 353,000-Person Coding Course for AI Agents
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle concluded a massive no-cost 'AI Agents Intensive' course, bringing together 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, fostering widespread skill development in agentic AI.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: Hugging Face released a guide on training and finetuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, providing essential knowledge for developers to create highly effective contextual embeddings for diverse AI applications.
